nodes.Name: withTempMemory
nodes.DocComment:
withTempMemory changes the working directory to a temp dir so
memory.json writes go there, then restores it after the test.

nodes.Name: TestHashError_Deterministic
nodes.DocComment: TestHashError_Deterministic verifies same input → same hash (needed for cache hits).

nodes.Name: TestHashError_Different
nodes.DocComment: TestHashError_Different verifies different inputs → different hashes.

nodes.Name: TestHashError_Length
nodes.DocComment: TestHashError_Length verifies the hash is exactly 16 hex chars (8 bytes × 2).

nodes.Name: TestLoadMemory_EmptyOnMissingFile
nodes.DocComment:
TestLoadMemory_EmptyOnMissingFile verifies that a missing memory.json
returns an empty Memory rather than an error.

nodes.Name: TestSaveAndLoad_RoundTrip
nodes.DocComment: TestSaveAndLoad_RoundTrip verifies that data survives a save+load cycle.

nodes.Name: TestRecordSuccess_IncrementsCount
nodes.DocComment:
TestRecordSuccess_IncrementsCount verifies that calling RecordSuccess twice
increments SuccessCount to 2.

nodes.Name: TestEvict_RemovesStaleEntries
nodes.DocComment:
TestEvict_RemovesStaleEntries verifies the eviction policy:
entries where FailCount >= SuccessCount * 2 should be evicted.

nodes.Name: TestEvict_DoesNotEvictEntryWithNoFailures
nodes.DocComment:
TestEvict_DoesNotEvictEntryWithNoFailures verifies that a perfect record
(all successes, zero failures) is never evicted.

nodes.Name: TestGet_MissFalse
nodes.DocComment: TestGet_MissFalse verifies that Get returns false for unknown hashes.
